game.q: lent fridays: no burgers, but fish is fine. why?
opts: the fish lobby got to someone
meat was feast food. fish was plain fare

wrong.lobby: a great conspiracy. not the reason.

game.right: YES. meat meant celebration, and friday is no feast. fish was everyday food, so it stayed.
